subject: Discovery recap & POC onboarding plan — FastRetail
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia@fastretail.com>, Carlos Ortega <c.ortega@fastretail.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap & POC onboarding plan — FastRetail

Hi Alicia / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have alignment before we propose a PoC plan: 

Pain points we heard:
- Latency spikes on peak shopping hours causing slow recommendation/summary features (p95 > 1.2s).
- High token costs on current hosted model workflow; finance wants predictable unit economics for seasonal spikes.
- Need for stricter data controls for user PII (hipaa-like requirements for some product lines).

Current stack:
- Frontend: React + Node backend; some serverless functions for light-weight inference.
- Existing ML infra: internal serving wrapped around open models (custom infra), primarily Python-based SDKs.

Success criteria for PoC (as discussed):
1) Reduce tail latency to p95 < 700ms for 512-token responses under test load.
2) Demonstrate >= 30% reduction in per-token cost vs current baseline using batching/caching/quantization options.
3) Prove that PII can be excluded from logs and meet FastRetail retention policy for test artifacts.

Proposed PoC / onboarding plan (high-level):
- Week 0: Kickoff + technical deep dive (confirm SDK language, network requirements, and sample payloads).
- Week 1-2: Integration: SDK embed + sample routes; validate API compatibility and auth.
- Week 3: Load testing + latency/cost baselining.
- Week 4: Final evaluation + handoff to ops for prod rollout path.

Owners on our side: Jordan Blake (integration lead, will handle SDK & API compatibility), Marissa Cole (customer success for rollout + success criteria tracking).

Action items / asks for FastRetail:
- Please confirm preferred SDK language (Python / Node) and a list of a couple sample endpoints you'd like to test.
- Any network restrictions (IPs, VPC/egress rules) we should be aware of for the technical deep-dive.
- If procurement needs a draft SOW for review, we can share a template (attached).

I've attached a short onboarding checklist and a draft SOW to get the ball rolling. Happy to jump on a 30-min technical deep-dive next week.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx, SOW-draft.pdf

From: Alicia Chen <alicia@fastretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ortega <c.ortega@fastretail.com>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC onboarding plan — FastRetail

Thanks Ben — this looks great and aligns with our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- SDK preference: Python first, Node as a follow-up if time permits. Our integration team writes most internal tooling in Python.
- Sample endpoints: product-recommendation (batch and real-time), checkout-autosuggest (low-latency).
- Network: we can whitelist Redwood's egress IPs; we'll confirm the list but we do have a corporate proxy for outbound traffic.
- Procurement: we'll need the SOW for internal review, and a short procurement questionnaire (we can send it after we validate the SOW).

One other ask: can you provide SOC 2 and data retention details in the next email or attach them to the SOW? Our security team will need that for the procurement path.

Happy to do kickoff + technical deep-dive the week of May 11th.

— Alicia
Alicia Chen
Head of Product Integrations | FastRetail
alicia@fastretail.com

Alicia — great, thanks for confirming Python and the sample endpoints. A few follow-ups and a proposed schedule with owners attached below.

What we'll deliver before kickoff:
- Updated SOW (attached) with PoC scope, timeline, and a checklist for procurement.
- SOC 2 summary + data retention notes included in the SOW appendix.
- A short integration README for the Python SDK and example payloads.

Proposed Milestones / Owners:
- Kickoff (May 11): Ben (commercial lead) + Jordan (technical lead) + FastRetail engineering + security
- Integration Sprint (May 12-20): Jordan (owner) — SDK install, sample route wiring, auth validation
- Load & Validation (May 21-25): Marissa (owner) — run defined tests, capture latency/cost metrics
- Evaluation & Next Steps (May 28): Joint review; if successful, discuss Dedicated/Private footprints for production.

PoC acceptance criteria (concrete):
- p95 latency < 700ms for the 512-token recommendation path under our test harness
- Cost per 1k tokens reduced by >= 30% vs your baseline (we'll need your baseline numbers)
- No user PII persisted in logs (we will show configuration that strips or mutes PII)

Attachments: SOW-draft.pdf, redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

We'll also send a short pre-kickoff questionnaire to capture sample payloads and baseline metrics from your side. Please share a couple example payloads (anonymized) before May 8 if possible.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
